item.title: Readings
item.description:
This section is divided into recommended textbooks, readings by session, and course notes. There are no required textbooks for this course.

Recommended Textbooks

A list of relevant textbooks is given below:

Strogatz, Steven H. Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos: With Applications to Physics, Biology, Chemistry, and Engineering. Boulder, CO: Westview Press, 2001. ISBN: 9780738204536.

Slotine, Jean-Jacques E., and Weiping Li. Applied Nonlinear Control. Upper Saddle River, NJ: Prentice Hall, 1991. ISBN: 9780130408907.

Fantoni, Isabelle, and Rogelio Lozano. Non-linear Control for Underactuated Mechanical Systems. New York, NY: Springer-Verlag, 2002. ISBN: 9781852334239.

item.title: Robotics Preliminaries
item.description: Course notes on deriving the equations of motion, and the manipulator equations.

item.title: The Acrobot and Cart-Pole
item.description: Course notes on the control of underactuated systems in the context of low-dimensional model systems. This chapter focuses on two of the most well-known and well-studied model systems: the Acrobot and the Cart-Pole.

item.title: The Simple Pendulum
item.description: Course notes on the dynamics of a pendulum.

item.title: Underactuated Robotics: Learning, Planning, and Control for Efficient and Agile Machines
item.description: Front matter to a set of course notes on underactuated robotics: learning, planning, and control for efficient and agile machines.

item.title: Walking
item.description: Course notes on simple models of walking robots, the control problems that result, and a very brief summary of some of the control solutions described in the literature.
